facts.text: Named to SUNY Canton's Dean's List for Fall 2017 as a Nursing student from Canton
Named to SUNY Canton's Dean's List for Fall 2024 in the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program
Named to SUNY Canton's Dean's List for Spring 2025 in the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program
Served as Co-President of the City of Plattsburgh's Climate Task Force, Mar 2026
Named a 2026 Women of Distinction honoree for Community and Civic Affairs by Assemblyman Michael Cashman, Mar 2026
At 16, ran a Canton maple operation whose wood-pellet-fired evaporator was the first of its kind in New York State, Mar 2014
Started as Deputy Director for Planning at the Adirondack Park Agency on Jan 24, 2022, coming from Vice President for Conservation at the Adirondack Council
Still plays viola at church, in small chamber music ensembles and in pit orchestras for musicals, and teaches music lessons to local students while working at North Country Savings Bank
Minored in Applied Physics and Mathematics at SUNY Canton while majoring in Mechatronics Technology
Tied for the highest male cumulative GPA in the SUNY Canton Athletics department entering his final semester

note: PM run. Checked 75 people and filed 10 bullets across 7 people, each verified on its source page by the parent and read back in the Sheet exactly once. Fresh sweep: none found — a dedicated sweep of items published Oct 21 to Nov 11 across NCPR, North Country Now, NNY360, WWNY and ClickNNY, the four colleges' news and athletics, honors announcements and health-system news found nothing new for a directory member; in-window items were already filed (Walczyk re-election, Tebo assist, Evans and Goettl at Union, Johnston award) or known-role mentions only. Filed: Katie Bertrand's Fall 2017 Dean's List semester at SUNY Canton (the page lists her as Katelyn Bertrand of Canton, Nursing, the same name form as her Spring 2018 graduation record); Katelyn Matthews's Fall 2024 and Spring 2025 Dean's List semesters in SUNY Canton's BSN program, section-checked on both pages; Ellie Jent's Co-Presidency of the City of Plattsburgh's Climate Task Force and her 2026 Women of Distinction honor (Sun Community News, Mar 2026); Josh Parker's 2014 wood-pellet-fired evaporator, the first of its kind in New York State (New York State Senate); and, from the compounding lane, Megan Phillips's Jan 24, 2022 start as Deputy Director for Planning at the Adirondack Park Agency, coming from Vice President for Conservation at the Adirondack Council (Sun Community News), Hudson Brown's current viola playing and music teaching alongside his North Country Savings Bank job, and Eli Larson's Applied Physics and Mathematics minor and tied-highest male cumulative GPA at SUNY Canton. Most batch claims were already on file in the live Sheet and were discarded, not re-filed: Norah Pease's second 90-Miler, Michelle Johnston's Shaffer Award study, Joye Levendusky's second King season, Ria Amo's accreditation working group, Hannah Holt's Swarthmore award, Debbie Gordon's 2013 appeal outcome, Alana Hoover's M Step 2 advance, Emmanuel Atindama's June 2025 paper, Patrick Tombs's REV Crutchie and Snow Goose casting, Dale Fournier's Buck Award, and Hannah Braun's Colorado State PhD. Nicole Seward's Nov 4, 2026 ROOTS blog post was logged, not filed — it sits on her own practice's blog, the same call as Nov 6 and Nov 10. Jason Deschaine's Oasis Grower Solutions hire came up again; JD dismissed that claim on Oct 30 from the same source, so it did not return. Hudson Brown's bank page title now calls him Loan Originator while the article body still says Floating Relationship Banker; a page title alone was logged, not filed. 2 candidates added to Research Command (ledger 587): Tim Swyka, whose name appears on Clarkson University's 2009 electric snowmobile design paper but with nothing tying him to his Potsdam record, and a compounding-lane card for Megan Phillips (Cornell degrees and a Road Salt Task Force appointment, from the Governor's Office). The Brianna Hammond media-production award and the Cashlynn Colbert baby-registry leads matched cards already in the ledger and were not duplicated. 5 of JD's console 'file' decision points reconciled into the change log (Angeles Felix x3, Cecilie Smith, Ian Blunt — all decided Nov 11). Unharvested photo leads flagged by JD remain: Christine Sutter, Emily Criscitello, Joe Charlebois, Katelyn Tomford, Kayla Hettel, Max Ferran, Megan Converse, Joann Duclos.
